title: Ideal-power product maps factor through lower powers
statement: For a scheme X, ideal sheaf I, map f : F ⟶ G, and n ≤ m, the composite of the inclusion I^m F ⟶ F with f factors through the inclusion I^n G ⟶ G.

source.place: Section 0EHN, equation 0880, construction of reduction maps

proof.text: On affine opens, I^m F is contained in I^n F for n ≤ m and f carries I^n F into I^n G. The induced factorization through the image defining I^n G is compatible with restriction, hence glues to a morphism of sheaves.

theorem formalModuleQuotient_factor {X : Scheme.{u}} (I : X.IdealSheafData)
    {F G : X.Modules} (f : F ⟶ G) {m n : ℕ} (h : n ≤ m) :
    ∃ k : Scheme.idealModuleProduct (Scheme.idealSheafPower I.toModulesι m).2 F ⟶
        Scheme.idealModuleProduct (Scheme.idealSheafPower I.toModulesι n).2 G,
      Scheme.idealModuleProductι (Scheme.idealSheafPower I.toModulesι m).2 F ≫ f =
        k ≫ Scheme.idealModuleProductι (Scheme.idealSheafPower I.toModulesι n).2 G
